acceptance_controls: Keep one fully completed exact-record native verification reusable within a single admission while separately rechecking expected producer, whole-versus-scoped authority and dependency-cycle constraints; a scoped ontology must never become a whole upstream.
Use deterministic offline call counters on a direct source plus a dependent source to demonstrate bounded replay/serialization counts; do not rely on fragile wall-clock thresholds.
Preserve failure on changed raw/DB bytes, raw locator replacement, SQLite sidecars, producer/query implementation changes, missing audit/marker, modified current graph or any missing consumed role.

Negative controls must still catch mutation or substitution of nested native physical-query, demand and label-batch evidence, recorded contracts, callbacks and admission cache membership; memoization must not simply trust mutable current state.
A new independent admission must redo its required native validation; incomplete or failed first checks must never populate a successful cache.
Require byte-identical accepted graph/audit identities, exact query witnesses, endpoint qualifications and scientific dispositions before and after any later optimization.

evidence.detail: validate_record caches (path, upstream, expected_source). The same completed whole BacDive record is replayed once for direct selection and again for first upstream selection; _check_record and native replay run before the context-specific scope/source checks. Subsequent equal upstream keys are cached.
MediaDive declares ontologies and BacDive dependencies. In the actual phase order this is the first phase3 upstream BacDive request; BactoTraits later uses the same cached upstream context.
Each native query calls _verify_files at lines61 and95, even for a cached query demand.
_verify_files invokes the shared SourceAdmission.verify(metadata_only=True) by default. This does not rehash DB bytes per query, but executes retained resolvers and all metadata/path/package guards.
Every verify calls every retained resolver before file metadata checks.

snapshot JSON-encodes and decodes the complete physical-query and demand arrays; finish_native line172 registers _encoded(snapshot()) as a retained resolver. After the first completed batch, later queries in the same admission repeatedly reconstruct/serialize this closed snapshot.

This path does not select the source ncbitaxon.db.

finish() deliberately performs full verification after a query batch; full admitted files may be rehashed at batch boundaries. This is separate from per-query metadata checks.
